checks: Studio and the focused native projector map the four-piece Shield_4 pack to typed shield_bonus 1/5; the native equipment report retains its source receipt and the attribute is not left unmodeled.
Real Nacupeda seed 0 owner-slot-0 grant at HP 1000 yields 240 with Shield_4 and 200 without it; existing shield settlement absorbs damage and keeps capacity fixed after grant.
Exact counterexample: static 2/10 plus live 3/10 sums to 1/2, so base 200 settles to 300 rather than 312; fractional 1003/4 times 3/2 rounds only once to 376 (rounding base first would produce 377).
Nacupeda grants read only the granter static and live shield_bonus; recipient-side shield bonuses are not queried. Static build requests default shield_bonus to zero.
Public NTE Nacupeda/Suit7 x4 selects the shield branch, checks independently calculated capacity and matches refreshed native, WASM and Worker reports.
Native reader binds Shield_2 DefUp 0.15 and Shield_4 ShieldEfficiency 0.2 with empty ConditionArray, additive entries, null SuitBuff, and thresholds 2 and 4; source hashes remain frozen.
Rainman live-HP self-grant strength and Solifugae live-shield ATK are modeled; global set release availability remains unverified.
decision: Model Kingdom’s Guard 2pc as the static native Shield_2 pack (DefUp +0.15) through the shared additive pack interpreter. Model the static 4pc Shield_4 pack (ShieldEfficiency +0.2) as outgoing shield strength on the granter: project it as typed shield_bonus, sum it with live granter shield_bonus at Nacupeda grant callback, multiply the captured exact HP-ratio base and round once. Existing admission HP capture, recipient, duration, ICD/RNG, replacement/absorption rules remain. Capacity is fixed after grant when modifiers expire. Adler Blessing shares the additive outgoing shield zone; Rainman self-grant strength and Solifugae live-shield ATK are modeled. Shield zone arithmetic is owned by COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 5.

four_piece.effect: Shield_4 pack: ShieldEfficiency +0.2, ConditionArray empty, EModifyModOp::MODIFY_MODOP_ADDITIVE
four_piece.reason: Nacupeda is a supported shield granter; its exact captured HP-ratio base is multiplied by one plus the granter’s static and live shield_bonus sum at the grant callback, with a single final nearest-integer settlement.
four_piece.return_condition: Extend shield_bonus consumption to other supported shield-grant owners when their owner models land; preserve granter ownership, the same additive zone and fixed settled capacity.
four_piece.studio_behavior: Projected into typed GameActorStaticStats.shield_bonus and consumed by Nacupeda grant settlement; not retained as an unmodeled attribute.

hypothesis_rationale: DT_EquipmentSuitData.rows.Suit7.SuitStructList binds threshold 2 to Shield_2 and threshold 4 to Shield_4, both with null SuitBuff. DT_EquipmentModifyData rows establish DefUp 0.15 and ShieldEfficiency 0.2 as single unconditional additive entries. The 2pc is consumed generically in the DEF percentage zone. The 4pc is projected to typed outgoing shield_bonus, whose formula is base * (1 + sum shield bonuses) on the granter. Nacupeda captures its exact MaxHP-ratio base at admission, then samples static plus live granter shield_bonus at the grant callback and rounds the product once; later modifier expiry does not rescale existing capacity. This callback read preserves the existing HP capture and settlement ordering.
independent_oracles: DefBase 50, DefAdd 1/3: at set_count 2, DefUp=3/20 and DEF=347/6; below two pieces DEF=151/3.
Studio set_count 2 gives def_percent=3/20 and DEF=58; below two pieces DEF=50.
At set_count 4, native ShieldEfficiency=1/5 and both Studio and native typed projections expose shield_bonus=1/5.
Nacupeda seed 0, HP 1000 and shield ratio 1/5: 200 without Suit7 and 200*(1+1/5)=240 with Suit7.
Independent additive check: static 2/10 + live 3/10 gives multiplier 3/2; a 200 base settles to 300, not 312.
Independent fractional check: (1003/4)*(3/2)=3009/8=376.125 settles to 376; rounding 1003/4 first gives 251*(3/2)=376.5 and 377.
limits: The equipped level-80 Nacupeda/Suit7 report has DefBase 848, DefUp 107/200 and DefAdd 0, producing DEF 32542/25 = 1301.68. Full native static projection remains rejected by the existing Q1-V7 fractional-DEF guard; the nearest flat correction is 8/25, outside published integer DefAdd increments.
Other native shield producers retain their owning gaps; Rainman foreign-recipient grants remain unsupported.
Studio set_count declares geometry applicability; native equipped builds still validate actual console packing. Full acquisition/release availability remains unverified.
scope: Suit7 static 2pc DEF and 4pc shield-strength projection; Nacupeda granter shield settlement
source_pointers: COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 5: shield_raw = [sum(stat_i * shield_coefficient_i) + shield_flat] * (1 + shield_bonus_sum)
